    FD with Premature Withdrawal option

    • Interest is paid for the actual period with the bank 
    • No interest for Domestic/NRO withdrawals within 7 days
    • No interest for NRE withdrawals within 1 year
    • Penalties for premature withdrawal as specified

     

    ICICI Bank FD Interest Rates

    • FD interest rates are subject to change without prior notice
    • The revised interest rates will apply to new as well as renewed FDs
    • FD interest payouts will be subject to Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) as per Income Tax Laws
    • If you change your account from Non-Resident to Resident, the Resident Deposit interest rates will be applicable
    • NRE rates are only for tenure of 1 year or more
    • Senior Citizens Fixed Deposit (FD) interest rates only apply for Domestic Fixed Deposits

    The rules below apply as per the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines in addition to the regular FD rules T&C. In case of a conflict, these terms shall prevail.

     

    Special Features of Fixed Deposits

    Below are the key features of FDs:

     

    • FDs offer assured returns which ensure stable financial growth
    • Senior citizens earn an additional 0.50% interest on Fixed Deposits, helping them maximise their returns
    • You can opt for flexible payout options – choose from monthly, quarterly, annual or cumulative payouts
    • The tenure of a Fixed Deposit can be selected as per your preference, ranging from 7 days to 10 years.

     

    Penalty on premature/partial closure for domestic, NRO and NRE deposit

    • In case of premature withdrawal, interest on the deposit shall be paid for the period that it has remained with the bank at the rate that prevailed at the time of booking for the actual tenure of the Term Deposit and not at the contracted rate and post deduction of applicable penalty
    • No interest if you withdraw the entire deposit amount within 7 days from the date of deposit for Domestic and NRO FDs
    • No interest if you withdraw NRE FDs within 1 year from the date of the deposit
    • Penalties for premature withdrawal are applicable as mentioned below

    FD without premature withdrawal facility for domestic, NRO and NRE deposits

    • Closure Policy: FDs cannot be closed before maturity, except in special cases
    • Interest Terms: If closure is allowed, no interest will be paid and credited interest will be deducted
    • ODFD Facilities: Not available for non-withdrawable Deposits
    • Rate Changes: Interest rates and minimum deposit amounts may change without notice
    • Auto-Renewal: Not available
    • NRO FD Duration: Minimum 3 months, maximum 10 years. Cumulative NRO FDs without withdrawal option: minimum 6 months
    • NRE FD Duration: Minimum 1 year
    • How to Open: Contact your Relationship Manager or visit any branch

    FD interest rates FAQ's

    Can I earn monthly interest on my Fixed Deposit?

    Yes, ICICI Bank offers a monthly income option on Fixed Deposits, allowing you to receive monthly interest payouts. To calculate the monthly FD interest amount, you can use our FD Interest Calculator. For detailed information, contact your Relationship Manager.

    Is the interest on a Fixed Deposit taxable?

    Yes, the interest earned on your ICICI Bank Fixed Deposit is taxable based on your income bracket and is subject to Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) as per Income Tax laws. You can also opt for a Tax Saver Fixed Deposit to save taxes up to ₹46,800 under the old tax regime.

    How much interest can I earn on my Fixed Deposit?

    ICICI Bank provides competitive Fixed Deposit interest rates ranging from a minimum of 2.75% to a maximum of 6.50% per annum. These secure and lucrative options make ICICI Bank a reliable choice for FD investments.

    What are Form 15G and Form 15H?

    Forms 15G and 15H can be submitted to avoid TDS deductions on interest income, provided you meet the eligibility criteria. Customers must have a PAN to claim tax exemptions and can submit these forms online via Net Banking or the iMobile app.

    When is TDS deducted on Fixed Deposit interest?

    TDS is deducted when the interest income exceeds  ₹50,000 for General Residents and ₹1,00,000 for Resident Senior Citizens. However, filing Forms 15G or 15H can prevent TDS deductions if eligible, but the interest income remains taxable.

    Will filing Form 15G / 15H exempt me from tax on my interest income?

    Submitting the forms only avoids TDS (Tax Deducted at Source) if your total income is below the taxable limit. If you do not submit the requisite form, the bank will deduct TDS which you will then have to claim as a refund later. If your taxable income is above the taxable limit, do not submit Form 15 GG or 15H.
